title: Research notes: Yahoo Falls
summary: Sources for Yahoo Falls in Big South Fork. Pin years are its public history (national forest 1937 to the Park Service in 1987), not geologic age.

items.text: About 113 ft single plunge on Yahoo Creek; NPS calls it Kentucky’s highest waterfall.
A Red River Gorge falls is said to exceed it by a few inches.
Falls in front of one of the park’s largest rock houses; walk behind; trickle in summer; 100-ft Yahoo Arch spur.
Cumberland National Forest created 1937; renamed Daniel Boone National Forest 1968.
1960s Yahoo Falls Recreation Area by forest supervisor Robert Collins: road, picnic area, campsite, trails, steel stairs.
Transferred to the NPS for Big South Fork in 1987; picnic shelter restored 2011; road paved 2016.
Local legends about the name and frontier events at the falls: not traced to contemporary records, so left out.

openQuestions: The exact year the recreation area opened.
